Senior Electrical Engineer, Analog & Mixed-Signal

Location: NYC

About Us

Voyant Photonics is transforming machine perception with a new class of LiDAR devices that are compact enough to fit in the palm of your hand and powerful enough to measure range, velocity, and reflectivity with unparalleled accuracy. By leveraging cutting-edge silicon photonic chips smaller than your fingertip, we deliver sensors that are not only revolutionary in performance but also affordable enough to integrate into any system.

Our technology disrupts the status quo of bulky, expensive, and power-hungry LiDAR systems, making high-precision sensing accessible for widespread adoption in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, industrial automation, and beyond. With Voyant, the next generation of machines can see, understand, and navigate the world like never before.

Discover how we're redefining what's possible by making real products out of cutting-edge research in silicon photonics.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a senior hardware leader to set the technical direction for the analog and mixed-signal electronics behind our LiDAR modules. You'll operate at the intersection of product design, silicon photonics, and machine perception — owning the hardest trade-offs, setting the standard other engineers build to, and mentoring the team as we scale. This is a high-leverage role for someone who wants their fingerprints on a foundational technology, not just a single product.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the analog and mixed-signal architecture for next-generation LiDAR modules, setting technical direction across TIAs, ADCs, precision current sources, and power delivery (LDOs, switching regulators).

  • Act as the technical authority on signal integrity, power integrity, and EMI/EMC across the product line — establish the design standards and review processes the rest of the team works to.

  • Lead bring-up, characterization, and validation strategy (EVT/DVT/PVT) across multiple concurrent programs, with accountability for robustness, repeatability, and manufacturability at scale.

  • Own the highest-stakes design trade-offs (performance, cost, power, integration complexity) that shape product roadmap and unit economics.

  • Mentor and provide technical direction to other hardware engineers; serve as the senior technical voice in cross-functional reviews with system architects, mechanical engineering, and firmware.

  • Drive supplier and component strategy for critical analog parts, engaging directly with vendors and foundries on custom or constrained components.

  • Represent hardware engineering in technical deep-dives with customers, partners, and investors as needed.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in hands-on hardware development, with end-to-end ownership of multiple systems shipped at high volume.

  • Leadership: Track record of setting technical direction for a team or product line — not only individual delivery.

  • Technical Strengths:

    • Recognized expert in low-noise analog and high-speed digital design.

    • Go-to authority on signal/power integrity, high-density interconnect, and EMI mitigation techniques.

    • Proven success driving designs through high-volume DFM, reliability testing, and yield optimization.

  • Tools & Skills:

    • Expert in schematic capture and simulation (e.g., SPICE), with deep fluency in Altium or similar.

    • Advanced use of SI/PI simulation tools (e.g., HyperLynx, SiWave) and measurement tools (GHz-range scopes, VNAs, spectrum analyzers).

    • Extensive experience integrating FPGAs, microcontrollers, and custom analog ASICs at the board level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in photonics, LiDAR, or other precision-sensing hardware.

  • Experience building or scaling a hardware engineering team, or serving formally as a technical lead/architect.

  • Knowledge of flex and rigid-flex PCB design.

  • Familiarity with Verilog-AMS, mixed-signal modeling, or FPGA development.

  • Experience designing for high-reliability or harsh environments (e.g., automotive, aerospace, defense).

Benefits Package

  • Competitive base salary and a meaningful equity package.

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision).

  • Unlimited PTO and paid company holidays.

  • Team events and company meetups.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Voyant Photonics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $140K - $170K

raw.description:
We are hiring a VC Analyst Intern to research the market and write what we find.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the ones that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

The role

Why is this company worth a look, and why now? Is this sector heating up, or is everyone already late to it? Which investor actually belongs in this round, and which one is only circling?

You answer those in writing. Every piece of work here is a memo. A view, the reasoning underneath it, and the part you are not sure about said out loud. The ones that hold up get published on our LinkedIn, the blog on our site, the newsletter and our X.

You also write for the two audiences we sell to. A family office and a pre seed founder want different things from the same piece of news, and a lot of what you write goes out from the founders' own accounts, in their voice.

You work with the two co-founders directly, and with our Head of Brand once that seat is filled. The org is very flat, so you learn straight from us how we screen, what we pass on and why.

This is a paid internship built to grow into a full time seat. We are looking for someone who already follows this market closely, has opinions about it, and wants to spend the next few years writing about it properly.

What you will own

  • Company memos. Why a company is interesting, who belongs in the round, and what would have to be true for it to fail.

  • Sector work. What is heating up, what is over owned, and the evidence behind both.

  • Investor research. Who is actually active, in what, at what stage, and what they are known for.

  • The published version of all of it, plus the pieces written for family offices and early stage founders that go out from the founders' accounts.

You are a fit if you

  • Already follow this market closely because you enjoy it. You can name the rounds from this quarter and say which ones you think are wrong.

  • Already write and research in this space, and turn that into memos or articles yourself.

  • Get the facts right. A wrong fund name, round size or attribution costs credibility we cannot buy back.

  • Use AI every day, and know where it should go nowhere near your work. Good judgement and taste on where it makes you faster, and where it degrades what you put out.

What we offer

Remote and async.

  • Close contact with the co-founders and our Head of Brand directly.

  • Close contact with our internal team.

  • Our network of highly established investors and the top deals out there.

  • Access to our internal processes, and to how we screen deal flow.

  • Learning very closely from all of us.

The Senior Clinical Data Engineer leads the strategic development and optimization of clinical data systems to support regulatory compliance, advanced analytics, and operational excellence across global trials.

This role drives enterprise-level data standardization initiatives, and architects scalable validation frameworks to proactively address systemic data issues. With deep expertise in SAS Programming in a Life Sciences setting, you'll be responsible for building and maintaining modular codebases, sets coding standards, and mentoring junior engineers. The role also oversees regulatory alignment with GCP and FDA 21 CFR Part 11, establishing robust documentation and audit trail protocols.

Through dynamic dashboards and analytics tools, you'll deliver actionable insights into trial performance and data quality. As a strategic liaison across Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory Affairs, you'll help translate clinical requirements into scalable technical solutions and leads the design of secure, high-performance databases and ETL pipelines integrating data from diverse clinical systems.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Data Standardization & Mapping: Spearhead the development of enterprise-level data mapping strategies that transform raw clinical data into standardized formats for high-impact analytics. Data Quality Assurance: Design and implement robust, scalable validation frameworks that proactively detect and resolve systemic data issues. Serve as a strategic partner to Clinical Data Managers and cross-functional teams, driving continuous improvement in data integrity across global trials

Programming & Scripting: Architect and maintain advanced, modular codebases using SAS to support complex data engineering workflows. Python, R, and SQL experience is highly preferred as we continue to leverage Ai tools across the industry. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Support: Act as a strategic liaison between Clinical Data Engineering and Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory Affairs. Translate clinical and scientific requirements into scalable technical solutions that support study execution and data delivery.

Database Design & Optimization: Lead the design and optimization of secure, high-performance relational databases and data lakes. Ensure infrastructure scalability, query efficiency, and data governance for large-scale clinical datasets.

The Role

This is a senior individual contributor role with a Creative Director title. You won't have direct reports on day one. You will own the creative output of the agency across brand strategy, design, copywriting, and video and motion work. You'll work directly with the Marketing Director and Account Director as a three-person leadership core, shaping the thinking behind every engagement and executing it at the level our clients expect.

The right person for this role wants the autonomy and ownership of a senior IC and is excited to grow into a leadership position as we hire creative talent under them. You'll set the bar, define the standards, and build the foundation a team will eventually scale on top of.

What You'll Own

Design. This is the primary need. Visual identity systems, campaign creative, web design partnership with our digital team, sales and marketing collateral, and pitch materials. You set the visual standard for everything that leaves the agency, and your hands are on the work.

Brand strategy. Positioning, messaging architecture, voice and tone, audience and persona development, naming, and the strategic briefs that drive every creative engagement. You'll work directly with our Differentiator Framework and help operationalize it for client work.

Copywriting. Brand messaging, web copy, campaign copy, sales narratives, and long-form content. You can write across registers, from a punchy headline to a thoughtful executive narrative.

Video and motion. You don't need to be a full-time editor or animator, but you should be able to direct video work, write scripts, storyboard concepts, and partner with production resources to deliver finished motion work.

Creative leadership. You'll be the creative voice in client conversations, internal strategy sessions, and new business pitches. You'll define how Plan Left's creative work shows up in the market.

Who You Are

You're a strong designer first. You've spent at least eight years honing your craft, with meaningful time as a senior designer, art director, associate creative director, or creative director. Your portfolio shows range and depth across brand identity, digital, and campaign work. Design is what got you here, and it's still where you do your best thinking.

You can also write. Plan Left's positioning lives or dies on language, and you don't need a copywriter to draft a headline, a tagline, or a clean piece of web copy. You won't always be the final word on copy, but you can hold your own.

You think in systems. You're as comfortable building a brand identity system as you are designing a landing page or directing a campaign. You believe the brief is where great work starts, and you push back when one is weak.

You have taste, opinions, and the ability to defend both. You can present work to a skeptical client and bring them along without compromising the idea.

You're a self-starter who thrives in remote work. You manage your own time, communicate proactively, and don't need to be in a room to do your best thinking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with a defined brand or strategy framework (ours is the Differentiator Framework, but any rigorous methodology counts)
  • Background working with PE-backed companies, professional services, or B2B technology brands
  • Experience building or scaling a creative team
  • Familiarity with AI tools as part of your creative process

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Full remote flexibility
  • Medical reimbursement
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • A clear path to building and leading a creative team as we grow

This role requires not just the deployment of models but also the development of organizational capabilities to deliver AI products at the pace of a startup.

This role does not focus on "AI strategy" in terms of presentation-making. You will be actively involved: reviewing pipelines, troubleshooting orchestration failures, making model selection decisions, managing complex coding workflows, and delivering production AI solutions that improve clinical care.

What You Will Own

1. AI/ML Strategy Across All Products

You will establish the AI roadmap and architecture for our assessment and care/practice products, as well as our infrastructure platform. Your crucial decisions will include model selection, orchestration frameworks, and determining when to build or buy solutions. Your architectural decisions will shape the platform for years to come.

2. AI Engineering Team

You will assemble and lead the AI engineering team, starting with one direct report and expanding to 3-4 team members. You will be responsible for hiring, setting performance standards, providing coaching, and cultivating the team's culture. Your goal will be to develop AI engineering talent capable of delivering at startup speed.

3. Production AI Infrastructure

You will design and implement scalable AI pipeline infrastructure. This includes creating systems that facilitate LLM orchestration, clinical NLP, and AI-generated insights. You will also establish monitoring, testing, and incident response protocols for all AI workflows. If a pipeline fails, it will be your duty to rectify it.

4. AI Cost as Production Constraint

You will regard AI costs as a key production constraint and ensure transparency in per-workflow and per-customer economics. Your role will involve monitoring and optimizing model usage, inference costs, and token consumption to ensure the economic viability at scale — not just in prototypes.

5. AI System Traceability and Explainability

You will guarantee that AI system behavior is explainable and debuggable for internal teams, rather than merely for end users. You will create observability and logging mechanisms that allow for understanding AI decisions, tracing inputs through the pipeline, and methodically debugging any failures.

6. Documentation and Process

You will develop an AI engineering playbook, documenting workflows, establishing testing standards, and creating runbooks for common incidents. Your effort will turn institutional knowledge from individual contributions into well-documented, transferable processes.

7. Clinical AI Innovation

You will assess and incorporate new models, frameworks, and orchestration tools as the field continues to advance. Staying ahead of the curve, you’ll ensure that Zenara's AI capabilities remain at the forefront of clinical applications.

Your First 90 Days

Week 1-2: Immerse yourself fully. Gain a comprehensive understanding of all AI workflows currently in production, review the existing pipeline architecture, identify significant technical debt and key opportunities, and build rapport with the team through active listening.

Month 1: Set documentation standards to begin capturing organizational knowledge. Define the AI testing and monitoring framework, create a technical roadmap that balances innovation with stability, and start monitoring AI costs by workflow.

Month 2-3: Implement monitoring and alerting for production AI workflows, develop traceability and logging systems for AI decision debugging, initiate the hiring process for your first team member, and commence architectural improvements — not a complete rewrite but a clear evolutionary path. Establish an AI governance framework to ensure clinical compliance.

Ongoing: Take charge of AI responsibilities. Introduce features that enhance clinical outcomes, expand the team, elevate performance expectations, and instill confidence in the CEO regarding the management of AI engineering.

Values & Vibe (Who You Are)

You see AI leadership as fundamentally about **ownership of outcomes** rather than merely exploring research. You thrive in chaotic AI environments, bringing order not through excessive academic rigor but through clarity, accountability, and effective execution. Your experience is rooted in startups or high-growth companies, rather than solely in research institutions. You find AI environments that resemble a black box—marked by heroic debugging rather than standardized practices—unacceptable.

You possess a hands-on approach that allows you to review code, resolve issues, and assess architecture, while understanding your primary responsibility is to empower your team rather than to merely be a contributing member. You have a track record of successfully launching tangible AI products that serve real users within specified timeframes. You comprehend the distinction between an intriguing model and one that reliably supports clinicians.

You have considered aspects related to AI safety, model governance, and production reliability, moving beyond a simplistic "we use the latest GPT" approach. You are aware of the trade-offs between model capabilities, costs, latency, and clinical accuracy, treating the economics of AI as a fundamental concern rather than an afterthought.

What Success Looks Like

  • AI systems consistently yield results, alleviating concerns for the CEO regarding pipeline failures
  • The AI roadmap is clear and aligns with the overall product strategy
  • AI costs are monitored on a per-workflow and per-customer basis, ensuring the business model scales effectively
  • AI system behavior is debuggable, enabling the team to trace decisions and diagnose issues without extraordinary measures
  • AI engineers have defined responsibilities, receive coaching, and benefit from continuous feedback
  • Architectural decisions are well-documented and thoughtfully made
  • Monitoring and alert systems detect issues before they are reported by users
  • The hiring pipeline is active, as you are developing the team while managing current personnel
  • Clinical teams have confidence in AI features due to their reliability
  • The AI organization is more robust, efficient, and trustworthy than it was when you joined

Requirements

Required

- 8 to 14 years of experience in software engineering, including a minimum of 3 years in leadership roles for AI/ML teams within the industry (not solely in academia). You have successfully delivered AI products to actual users.

- Extensive experience with LLM orchestration frameworks at production scale (such as Dify, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent). You have designed and managed production AI pipelines.

- Hands-on experience deploying AI in healthcare or regulated sectors — you are familiar with compliance challenges and have navigated them successfully.

- Strong architectural mindset — you build systems and infrastructure rather than just prompts. You can evaluate issues related to scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

- Experience with agentic AI workflows and AI-assisted coding pipelines — you appreciate how modern AI teams operate within this framework.

- Supervised teams of 2 to 5+ AI engineers — responsible for direct management, hiring, performance assessments, and mentoring.

- Excellent English communication abilities — you adopt an async-first approach, creating clear written decision memos, technical designs, and risk reports. You effectively document both your decisions and the reasons behind them.

- Startup or fast-paced growth experience — you have thrived in settings defined by uncertainty, resource constraints, and tight deadlines.

Strongly Preferred

- Background in healthcare SaaS (EHR, billing, clinical workflows, HIPAA)

- Knowledge of clinical NLP and behavioral health applications

- Contributions to published research or open-source projects in ML/NLP (though practical industry experience is prioritized)

- Experience in developing AI infrastructure platforms (beyond mere applications)

- Familiarity with observability and monitoring strategies for AI systems

- Skills in managing AI cost budgets and optimizing inference costs

Nice to Have

- Understanding of FHIR/HL7 healthcare data standards

- Experience with multi-tenant SaaS AI deployments

- Awareness of SOC 2 or similar compliance standards

- Exposure to mental health or behavioral health fields

- Knowledge of FDA AI/ML compliance regulations

Schedule

Evening IST hours with 4–8 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time (9am–5pm PT). You are welcome to propose a schedule that best fits your needs — our priority is on ensuring availability and overlap for the team rather than imposing strict clock-in times. Leadership presence is anticipated during critical deployments or incidents.

Benefits

Benefits

  • Compensation: Well above market for Indian startups at this level. We pay for the caliber we're hiring.
  • Opportunities for fully remote work available throughout India
  • Equipment allowance included
  • Local holidays recognized and observed (India)
  • Flexible paid time off policy
  • Funding available for leadership development and coaching
  • Direct and frequent communication with the CEO, allowing you to connect without intermediaries
  • The chance to build an AI organization from the ground up in a clinically relevant field

raw.description:
Description

We’re looking for a motivated Junior Developer to help us build reliable, modern software solutions as part of our growing engineering team.

Do you enjoy learning new technologies, writing clean code, and improving a little every day? Are you excited about turning ideas into working features? We're looking for someone who can collaborate closely with teammates, follow established development practices, and help build solid, maintainable applications.

This is a hands-on development role where you’ll focus on implementing well-defined features, learning best practices, and growing your technical foundation. You’ll work within an established architecture, supported by experienced engineers who will guide you through design decisions, patterns, and development processes.

You’ll contribute across the stack—building APIs, developing UI components, working with databases, and delivering features that teams and customers rely on.

What Will You Be Doing?

Application Development

You will:

  • Develop features using .NET (C#) and ASP.NET Core
  • Build and extend REST APIs
  • Create UI components using Angular or React
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend services
  • Apply foundational understanding of:
    • HTTP protocol
    • Request/response lifecycle
    • Status codes
    • Basic API design principles

Your focus will be on implementing features in accordance with clear technical guidelines.

Code Quality & Design Principles

You should demonstrate:

  • Understanding of SOLID principles
  • Familiarity with Clean Code practices
  • Knowledge of common GoF design patterns
  • Understanding of layered architecture (Controller → Service → Repository)

You’ll apply these concepts under the guidance of senior engineers.

Microservices & Cloud Awareness

You will need a conceptual understanding of:

  • What microservices are
  • Basic cloud concepts (Azure / AWS)
  • Cloud storage (Blob / S3)
  • Environment separation (Dev, QA, Prod)

Your role is to work within the existing architecture—not define it.

Data & Persistence

You will:

  • Work with relational databases (MS SQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Understand relationships and normalization basics
  • Use Entity Framework for CRUD operations
  • Understand basic indexing concepts
  • Be aware of NoSQL systems (Cosmos DB conceptually)

You’ll extend existing models rather than design full database strategies.

Security & API Fundamentals

You should understand:

  • Authentication vs. authorization
  • JWT basics
  • Role-based access control
  • Basic REST security practices

You’ll implement defined security flows and patterns.

Tools & Development Process

You are expected to:

  • Use Git effectively (branching, merging, pull requests)
  • Follow the team’s branching strategy
  • Use debugging tools
  • Implement logging and error handling
  • Participate fully in Scrum ceremonies
  • Deliver tasks within sprint commitments

Who You Are (Non-Technical Skills)

Ownership (Task-Level)

  • Take responsibility for assigned work
  • Communicate blockers early
  • Deliver within the agreed scope

Learning Mindset

  • Eager to learn and grow
  • Accept and apply feedback
  • Show initiative with new tools and technologies

Communication

  • Communicate clearly within the team
  • Collaborate respectfully
  • Participate actively in team processes

Who we are

Init is a group of software and automation companies offering sustainable, innovative, and long-term solutions to various Nordic and worldwide industries. Init was established in January 2022 by 17 companies joining forces. Today, it has over 900 highly qualified employees in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, North Macedonia, UK and Spain.

At Init, we focus on people, and as a people-first company, we see it as our most important task to help and support talented people by offering some of the most exciting challenges in the industry. We emphasise providing you with a fun, safe and inclusive working environment so you may feel a burning desire to come to work every day. In short, we do everything possible to make Init a positive part of your life. Our motto is "We are Init together." This applies when we collaborate with colleagues to make Init an attractive workplace and with customers to shape the future within automation and IT.

Read more about Init at www.initgroup.com

To grow the Autodesk Construction business by using both direct sales and a channel sales ecosystem including closing deals directly by client engagement. Work as part of a team to identify and define customer goals, develop solutions proposals, set appropriate expectations, and coordinate hand offs to the implementation teams. Build relationships with strategic clients by coordinating all available resources to exceed customer expectations.

Responsibilities

Minimum Requirements

raw.title: Head of Data
raw.excerpt: Welcome to Fi. We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship.
raw.description:
Welcome to Fi.

We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? Develop cutting-edge technology to revolutionize what it means to be a pet parent. The pet industry remains firmly stuck in the past and we are here to change that. Fi is leveraging our team's talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring – and that's just the beginning.
The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That's the future we're building at Fi.
If you're someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together.

Fi is looking for a Head of Data!Fi is looking for a Head of Data to own our data platform end to end. You'll model our device, membership, and operational data into the pipelines and warehouse layers the company runs on, lead a team of four analysts, and be the numbers person Finance and Product turn to for board reporting, forecasting, and experiment reads. This is a hands-on role for someone who's built a data function before and wants to do it again, this time with real leverage.

What You'll Do:

  • Own Fi's data platform and analytics roadmap: model our device, membership, and operational data into pipelines and warehouse layers the whole company can build on
  • Design and maintain event-driven, incremental pipelines over raw device telemetry — turning millions of collar signals into usable product and fleet data models
  • Manage, coach, and grow a team of four analysts; run their pipeline of work, unblock them technically, and raise the bar on rigor and documentation
  • Partner with Finance on subscription and unit economics: membership forecasting, retention and LTV modeling, hardware margin, and the reporting our board and investors see
  • Partner with Product and Hardware on activation, engagement, and device performance analytics — including the sensor and firmware data behind features customers actually feel
  • Build self-serve BI that stakeholders genuinely use, rather than a dashboard graveyard
  • Design and read experiments on pricing, onboarding, and retention, and hold the org to honest interpretation of results
  • Shift the data team from a ticket-taking service function into a strategic partner embedded in the business

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years in analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or analytics engineering, including time as the person who built or substantially rebuilt a data function
  • Experience leading analysts — formally or as a player-coach — with a real point of view on how to develop them
  • Deep SQL, plus hands-on work in a modern warehouse and orchestration stack (Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Airflow, dbt or similar)
  • Fluency in dimensional and event-driven modeling, and clear opinions on ELT tradeoffs, incremental builds, and cost control
  • Strong BI craft in Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent — you build for the stakeholder, not the demo
  • Comfort partnering with Finance on models that carry real consequences: forecasts, diligence materials, margin analysis
  • Ability to work in ambiguity at Series B scale, where you'll sometimes be the entire data team for a given problem

Why You'll Love Us:

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy flexible PTO to take the breaks you need.
  • Top-Notch Health Coverage: We’ve got your back (and teeth and eyes) with full medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Wellness Perks: Free access to One Medical, Kindbody, and Talkspace to keep you feeling your best.
  • Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your pup to work — they’re part of the team, too.
  • Give Back to the Pups: Make tails wag with a $500 annual donation to a dog charity of your choice through our BarkBack Program.
  • Free Fi Membership: Your furry best friend(s) get all the benefits of a Fi collar, on us!
  • Love for Friends + Family: Share the Fi magic with loved ones through our gifting program.
The anticipated base salary range for this position is $150,000–$300,000. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including skills, experience, market conditions, and role scope, which may evolve during the hiring process. As a fast-growing Series B startup, Fi evaluates compensation opportunistically to align with the right candidate. This role is also eligible for equity compensation.
Fi is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Fi makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and our needs at the time.

raw.excerpt: About TouchBistroTouchBistro is an all-in-one restaurant management platform built to help restaurant operators run stronger, more successful businesses.
raw.description:
About TouchBistro

TouchBistro is an all-in-one restaurant management platform built to help restaurant operators run stronger, more successful businesses. Our solutions span point of sale, payments, front-of-house and back-of-house operations, and guest engagement. As part of Harris Computer, TouchBistro combines the focus and agility of a restaurant technology company with the long-term orientation of a leading vertical market software organization.


The Opportunity

TouchBistro is seeking an experienced Vice President, Sales & Marketing to lead an integrated go-to-market organization across North America. Reporting to the EVP, this executive will translate company strategy into a focused commercial plan, build a predictable and efficient revenue engine, sharpen our market position, and develop high-performing Sales and Marketing teams.

This is a hands-on executive role for a leader who can connect market insight, product value, demand generation, sales execution, pricing, brand, content, web, analytics, and marketing operations. The successful candidate will bring clarity to how TouchBistro targets the right customers, communicates differentiated value, creates and converts demand, and measures performance from first touch through booked and live recurring revenue.

What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, company-wide commercial strategy that defines priority markets, ideal customer profiles, channel choices, value propositions, and measurable growth outcomes.
  • A predictable funnel with disciplined forecasting, strong pipeline hygiene, clear stage definitions, and transparent conversion performance from lead through booking and activation handoff.
  • Improved sales and marketing efficiency, with investment decisions grounded in customer quality, unit economics, expected lifetime value, payback, and live recurring revenue.
  • Stronger product positioning, pricing discipline, launch execution, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement across the TouchBistro portfolio.
  • One integrated Sales and Marketing operating rhythm, with shared priorities, clear accountability, fast learning cycles, and a culture of coaching and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Growth Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the overall Sales and Marketing strategy and operating plan, aligned to TouchBistro’s business priorities, financial objectives, product roadmap, and customer strategy.
  • Translate growth objectives into market, segment, channel, capacity, investment, and talent plans with clear assumptions and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Sales and Marketing leadership team; establish clear decision rights, performance expectations, succession plans, and career paths.
  • Create an integrated operating cadence across Sales and Marketing, including weekly execution reviews, monthly funnel and forecast reviews, and quarterly business planning.
  • Act as a key member of the executive leadership team, bringing a market- and customer-informed perspective to company strategy, resource allocation, and portfolio decisions.

Sales Strategy, Pipeline & Execution

  • Own delivery of new-business revenue targets and the commercial performance of inbound, outbound, and business development motions.
  • Build a disciplined, repeatable sales process covering lead response, qualification, discovery, demonstration, solution fit, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
  • Establish consistent definitions and controls for pipeline creation, stage progression, conversion, forecast categories, sales-cycle velocity, win/loss analysis, and CRM hygiene.
  • Align account coverage, territories, quotas, capacity, and compensation with priority customer segments and expected demand.
  • Develop high-performing sales leaders and teams through structured onboarding, coaching, call review, playbooks, feedback, and clear career paths.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Operations to ensure honest expectations, clean handoffs, customer readiness, and stronger conversion from sold to live.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for strategic prospects, customers, RFPs, and complex commercial negotiations when appropriate.

Demand Generation & Revenue Marketing

  • Set the inbound and outbound demand generation strategy across paid search, SEO, lifecycle nurture, paid social, website, events, webinars, account-based programs, and other relevant channels.
  • Allocate budgets across markets, audiences, and channels based on pipeline contribution, customer quality, conversion, ACV, payback, and return on investment.
  • Build an experimentation roadmap to improve audience targeting, offer design, channel mix, lead quality, conversion, and speed to learning.
  • Create tight alignment between Marketing and Sales on campaign priorities, service-level expectations, lead routing, follow-up, qualification, and feedback loops.
  • Balance short-term pipeline creation with long-term category credibility, brand strength, customer advocacy, and organic demand.

Product Marketing, Pricing & Go-to-Market

  • Own the commercial articulation of TouchBistro’s value proposition, product positioning, messaging architecture, proof points, and differentiation by customer segment and use case.
  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new products, bundles, features, releases, and market entries in partnership with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations.
  • Build a disciplined pricing and packaging capability informed by customer value, competitive dynamics, willingness to pay, margin, attach potential, and long-term unit economics.
  • Institutionalize market and competitive intelligence and translate insights into positioning, enablement, pricing, roadmap input, and commercial action.
  • Ensure Sales has the tools, training, battlecards, pricing guidance, customer stories, presentations, and collateral required to sell value consistently.

Brand, Content, Community & Communications

  • Define and protect TouchBistro’s brand strategy, voice, narrative, and standards across digital and traditional customer touchpoints.
  • Oversee an integrated content strategy spanning thought leadership, SEO and answer-engine visibility, product content, customer stories, newsletters, nurture, social media, events, podcasts, webinars, and sales collateral.
  • Ensure content is grounded in restaurant operator needs, product value, customer evidence, industry trends, and clear business objectives across the funnel.
  • Strengthen community engagement, customer advocacy, employee advocacy, and social listening while ensuring timely, consistent brand interaction.
  • Use research and original insights to build credibility in restaurant technology and create reusable demand, PR, sales, partner, and customer assets.

Digital Experience & Web

  • Treat the website and digital ecosystem as core commercial products that support discovery, education, conversion, and customer trust.
  • Own the web roadmap, conversion strategy, user journeys, landing-page effectiveness, accessibility, SEO foundations, performance, scalability, and content-management governance.
  • Use analytics, behavioral data, experimentation, and A/B testing to continuously improve digital conversion and campaign performance.
  • Ensure web development, design, content, product marketing, demand generation, and marketing operations work from shared priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Oversee external agencies and vendors where needed, with clear scope, accountability, quality standards, and return expectations.

Marketing Operations, Data & Technology

  • Own marketing processes, automation, campaign operations, lead management, attribution, data quality, consent and governance, and the effectiveness of the marketing technology stack.
  • Ensure reliable integration between marketing platforms and CRM, with clear lifecycle definitions, routing, scoring, source tracking, and closed-loop reporting.
  • Develop dashboards that connect activity and spend to pipeline, booked ACV, live ACV, customer quality, payback, and retention-relevant indicators.
  • Create a trusted performance narrative by combining data with actionable insight, identifying root causes, and recommending clear management actions.
  • Simplify tools and workflows, automate repetitive work, and use AI responsibly to improve targeting, content operations, seller productivity, analysis, and speed of execution.

Cross-Functional Commercial Alignment

  • Partner closely with Product to bring customer and competitive insight into roadmap choices, business cases, packaging, launches, and lifecycle decisions.
  • Partner with Finance on targets, budgets, forecast assumptions, unit economics, deal quality, pricing governance, and investment trade-offs.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Operations to improve sales-to-activation handoffs, surface expectation gaps, support retention, and create customer expansion and advocacy opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships with strategic customers and ecosystem partners and represent TouchBistro at relevant industry events and executive forums.
  • Promote direct communication, clear ownership, and shared metrics across the full customer journey.

Performance Management

The VP will establish a concise executive scorecard and use it to drive decisions, accountability, and continuous improvement. Measures are expected to include:


Growth : Booked ACV, live ACV, new recurring revenue, average deal size, attainment by channel and segment

Funnel : Pipeline coverage, lead-to-opportunity conversion, win rate, sales-cycle velocity, forecast accuracy

Efficiency : Sales and Marketing spend to live ACV, CAC and payback, channel ROI, quota capacity and productivity

Customer quality : Ideal-customer mix, sold-to-kickoff and sold-to-live conversion, early-life churn indicators, expectation quality

Marketing : Qualified pipeline contribution, website conversion, content and nurture influence, attribution quality, brand and share-of-voice indicators

Execution : CRM hygiene, speed to lead, campaign delivery, launch readiness, pricing compliance, enablement adoption

People : Engagement, retention, leadership bench strength, ramp time, coaching effectiveness, succession coverage

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience across Sales, Marketing, business development, revenue growth, or related functions, including significant leadership-of-leaders responsibility.
  • Proven success leading an integrated go-to-market organization in B2B SaaS, vertical market software, payments, restaurant technology, hospitality technology, or a comparable high-volume commercial environment.
  • Demonstrated accountability for revenue targets, demand generation, pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, budgets, and commercial performance.
  • Strong command of SaaS unit economics, funnel analytics, attribution, customer acquisition, payback, retention dynamics, and investment trade-offs.
  • Experience building disciplined sales processes and coaching teams across inbound, outbound, transactional, and complex sales motions.
  • Experience leading product marketing, positioning, messaging, go-to-market launches, pricing and packaging, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement.
  • Working knowledge of modern marketing operations, CRM, automation, analytics, web conversion, content, SEO, lifecycle marketing, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Strong executive presence, commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with employees, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • A builder’s mindset: strategic enough to set direction, analytical enough to challenge assumptions, and hands-on enough to improve execution.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered. MBA is an asset.
  • Restaurant, hospitality, POS, payments, or multi-location software experience is a strong asset.
  • English required; French is a strong asset for the Canadian market. Ability to travel within North America as required.

Leadership Profile

Commercially rigorous : Makes allocation and pricing decisions using evidence, unit economics, and customer value.

Customer-centered : Understands restaurant operators and insists that promises, products, and delivery stay aligned.

Clear and accountable : Sets a small number of priorities, assigns ownership, and addresses gaps directly and constructively.

Integrated thinker : Connects brand, product, demand, sales, activation, retention, and expansion rather than optimizing silos.

Talent builder : Develops leaders, raises the performance bar, and creates a coaching culture with visible career paths.

Adaptive operator : Tests, learns, and changes course quickly without sacrificing standards, data quality, or customer trust.

What We Offer

  • A high-impact executive mandate with direct influence on TouchBistro’s growth strategy and operating model.
  • The opportunity to lead an established Sales and Marketing organization through its next stage of focus, integration, and performance.
  • A collaborative environment with access to the broader Harris Computer network and long-term operating perspective.
  • Flexible work arrangements, competitive executive compensation with performance-based incentives, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Salary range: $120,000–$150,000 CAD annually, depending on experience.

Application & Equal Opportunity

*Only selected candidates will be contacted.

Harris is committed to an equal employment opportunity program, and applications from members of designated groups, including women, persons with disabilities, Indigenous peoples, and visible minorities, are encouraged. If you are a person with a disability, you may request assistance with the recruitment and selection process.

raw.title: SEO/AEO Manager
raw.excerpt: Growth Marketing Pro began as a leading marketing blog and has since become a growth marketing agency working with 50+ businesses.
raw.description:
Growth Marketing Pro began as a leading marketing blog and has since become a growth marketing agency working with 50+ businesses. Technically, we're an agency, but we don't think of ourselves as one. Our clients use us as a fractional SEO/organic growth team: a superpower they plug into their business to unlock fast, profitable growth.

We're hiring an SEO/AEO Account Manager to deliver WOW results for our organic marketing engagements. Our programs are rooted in SEO and have expanded into what we call Search Everywhere Optimization - AI visibility, citation-earning off-page content, and Reddit organic marketing (we're writing the playbook in these interrelated fields). We deliver on a broader set of organic strategies than anyone else in the game, and bring "ahead of the curve" plays to clients backed by data from across our portfolio.

In this role, you'll directly manage a portfolio of clients, serving as the point of contact and owner of each engagement. You'll function as a fractional Head of SEO, providing strategic leadership of the client's organic program while personally managing the execution that drives results. You'll leverage your existing marketing experience (SEO, content marketing, analytics) combined with intellectual curiosity and a natural inclination to test cutting-edge tactics - and get the opportunity to help build a scaling startup into an industry-leading growth marketing company.

What You'll Own

  • The client relationship: serve as the primary point of contact and owner of the engagement end to end; deeply understand the client’s business goals, establish the KPIs and strategy to achieve them, and operate as an extension of their team
  • Communicate proactively with clients and our internal team – regular check-ins between meetings, flagging anomalies early, and keeping clients informed without waiting for a scheduled touchpoint
  • The strategy and roadmap: own the client’s strategy and deliverable roadmap – build monthly strategies grounded in keyword intent with a laser focus on high-intent keywords that convert, sequence the work, and rigorously manage deliverables, milestones, and ETAs across internal teams and vendors
  • Execution across SEO and AEO: SEO and content campaigns built end-to-end with our in-house Content Team, off-page content that earns citations and brand mentions across Reddit, YouTube, and digital PR, and technical site issues identified and resolved with our web dev resources
  • Help write the playbook for AI visibility – how website content, off-site content, and authority drive a brand's presence across Google and AI platforms like ChatGPT and AI Overviews - and recommend and implement A/B tests, CRO improvements, and similar experiments
  • Measurement, reporting, and results: work in Google Search Console, GA4, HubSpot, and AI search performance tools to track changes and extract the learnings that guide your strategy, and tie performance to the bottom line - conversions, pipeline, and revenue
  • Deliver detailed monthly reporting on the KPIs the client actually cares about and be a storyteller: analyze the “why” and “so what” behind the numbers, clearly communicate what’s working, what’s not, and what we should focus on now, next, and later
  • Growth beyond the scope: be a strategic partner beyond the initial scope by suggesting new channel tests, CRO improvements, and tracking setups, and identifying upsell opportunities

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years delivering revenue growth and business impact through SEO, ideally including in-house experience at a startup or scaling business where exposure across channels is common
  • Fluency in the tools: Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, CRM platforms like HubSpot, and a working familiarity with AI search visibility tracking tools
  • Analytical and results-oriented: you can accurately gather and analyze data to understand SEO + AEO performance. Strong in GA4 and spreadsheets; an "analyst" title somewhere in your background is a plus
  • Rigorous execution and GSD: a bias to action, able to prioritize and execute against a high workload, with keen attention to detail and the ability to keep stakeholders accountable
  • Advanced AI adoption: you're a proficient GPT and Claude user, you use tools like Claude Cowork and Claude Code
  • Artful communicator: strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to tell stories that persuade others to take action. Active listener, sympathetic to the client's situation but unafraid to disagree and offer a counter viewpoint grounded in data
  • Extreme ownership: you treat your clients like your own business. On multi-channel accounts, you stay close to what's happening in other channels, even when they aren't your department
  • Not just an SEO, but a broader "Growth Marketing Pro": you can answer broad strategic growth questions by drawing on experience and pattern matching, hold an informed opinion on CRO and the full funnel, and understand paid search and paid social well enough to advise clients on when and how to use them
  • Resourceful with a growth mindset: you're a pro at teaching yourself new things, you're constantly testing new strategies and documenting the learnings so other clients benefit, and you enjoy the continuous learning process of growth marketing

Bonus points

  • Experience with Reddit organic marketing, digital PR, or community-led growth
  • Hands-on CRO or conversion tracking implementation experience
  • Early experimentation with AEO/AI visibility work

Benefits

  • Compensation: $85,000 – $125,000 per year
  • We’re fully remote. We believe great work happens when people have the freedom to work in the way that works best for them. We trust our team to set their own schedules, do their best work, and get the job done without micromanagement.
  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays. Work-life balance is one of GMP’s core values, and we genuinely live by it. Take the time you need to recharge and enjoy life outside of work.
  • Great healthcare benefits. Choose from a variety of medical plans with dependent coverage, plus dental and vision benefits.
  • 401 (k) retirement planning. GMP offers a 401(k) plan with employer contribution, helping you build long-term financial security while you build your career.
  • Performance-based compensation. Your impact matters, and there are opportunities to grow your compensation as you grow and perform.
  • Room to grow. Work alongside talented growth marketers, sharpen your skills, learn from experts, and build your career in the areas that excite you most.
  • Make a real impact. Join a fast-growing startup where your work isn’t just another task on a list—you’ll have a meaningful opportunity to shape the direction and success of the business.
Salary: $85,000 – $125,000 / year

description: About the ClientWe’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.

raw.title: Financial Analyst - Accounting & Advisory
raw.excerpt: About the ClientWe’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.
raw.description:
About the Client

We’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.

The firm works with entrepreneurs, established businesses, institutions, and international clients across strategic and financial advisory, corporate services, accounting and bookkeeping, back-office administration, and project management. Its clients span a variety of industries, including healthcare, professional services, government, and other service-based businesses.

The Role

We’re looking for a Financial Analyst – Accounting & Advisory to support the financial reporting, analysis, and research that underpin the firm's strategic advisory work.

The role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, financial analysis, and advisory support. You’ll work across multiple client businesses, preparing and analyzing P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, monthly financial packs, and straightforward forecasts while ensuring the senior advisory team has accurate and well-structured financial information to work from.

This is not primarily a valuation or complex financial modeling role. Instead, you'll develop a strong understanding of the financial operations of different businesses and turn their numbers into useful insights and structured outputs that support strategic decision-making.

There may also be research, commercial analysis, and project work depending on the needs of each client. As you develop, there is an opportunity to become increasingly involved in the strategic advisory side of the business.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Bahamas working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You’ll Do

Financial Reporting & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and maintain P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports across multiple client accounts.

  • Prepare recurring monthly financial and management reporting packs using established templates and processes.

  • Review and organize financial information to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Analyze financial performance and identify relevant trends, movements, discrepancies, and areas requiring attention.

  • Support the financial back-office requirements of non-finance businesses across different industries.

  • Maintain well-organized financial information and supporting documentation across client accounts.

  • Learn and work with client-specific accounting systems, processes, and proprietary software where required.

Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare and maintain straightforward financial forecasts and projections.

  • Support cash flow planning and other forward-looking financial analysis.

  • Analyze historical and current financial performance to help inform business decisions.

  • Assist with financial analysis relating to commercial credit, loan financing, and other business requirements where needed.

  • Translate financial data into clear and structured information for senior team members.

  • Flag unusual movements, inconsistencies, or areas that warrant further investigation.

The modeling requirements for this role are relatively straightforward. You won't be expected to build complex valuation or transaction models; the emphasis is on strong financial fundamentals, accurate reporting, practical forecasting, and understanding what the numbers mean for the business.

Strategic Advisory & Research Support

  • Prepare financial information and analysis used by senior team members in client-facing strategic advisory work.

  • Conduct business, financial, market, or industry research where required for client assignments.

  • Gather and structure information needed to support strategic recommendations.

  • Help turn financial and research findings into clear reports, presentations, and other client-facing materials.

  • Support senior team members with ad hoc analysis for different business challenges and opportunities.

  • Develop an understanding of each client's business model, operations, and commercial environment rather than looking at financial information in isolation.

Client & Project Support

  • Work across multiple client accounts and adapt to different industries, business models, and reporting requirements.

  • Support project coordination, documentation, and follow-up across advisory engagements.

  • Manage recurring deliverables and ensure financial information is prepared accurately and on time.

  • Assist with broader analytical and administrative requirements connected to client projects.

  • Take increasing ownership of client work as your understanding and capabilities develop.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Ideally 3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, FP&A, management reporting, corporate services, or a similar finance-focused environment. However, practical capability is more important to us than a specific number of years.

  • Academic background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements and how they work together.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and analyzing financial reports and management information.

  • Comfortable preparing straightforward forecasts and financial projections.

  • Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and confidence working with financial data.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, and relevant insights from financial information.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and recognize when issues need to be escalated.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in professional services, corporate consultancy, accounting, FP&A, or financial advisory.

  • Experience supporting multiple external client accounts.

  • Experience working with SMEs or service-based businesses.

  • Exposure to healthcare, medical, dental, government, or other professional-services clients.

  • Understanding of commercial lending, loan financing, or credit analysis.

  • Experience preparing management reports and financial projections.

  • Previous exposure to strategic advisory or consulting projects.

  • Experience conducting business, market, or industry research.

  • Experience managing or supporting financial back-office operations for non-finance businesses.

  • Experience working across multiple industries.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re someone who is strong with numbers but also interested in the business behind them.

You can confidently work with P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flows, prepare reliable financial reporting, maintain forecasts, and spot when something doesn’t look right. At the same time, you’re curious about why the numbers are moving and what they mean for the business.

You may come from accounting, FP&A, financial analysis, consulting, or even a more traditional financial analyst background. What matters most is that you're comfortable with the practical financial work involved and genuinely interested in supporting businesses across a range of financial and strategic challenges.

This could also be a good fit for someone with a more modeling- or transaction-oriented finance background who is looking to move into a role with less emphasis on complex modeling and transactions and greater exposure to ongoing business operations and strategic advisory.

You’re organized, adaptable, commercially curious, and comfortable switching between financial reporting, forecasting, research, and project work across different client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a reliable extension of the advisory team who can independently manage high-quality financial preparation and analysis across multiple clients.

You’ll progressively reduce the financial preparation required from senior team members by ensuring reports, financial packs, forecasts, research, and supporting information are accurate, well-structured, and ready for use in strategic discussions.

As your understanding of the clients and advisory work develops, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility across financial analysis, research, strategic advisory, and project support.

Why Join?

  • Gain exposure to the financial operations and strategic challenges of multiple businesses and industries.

  • Work closely with experienced professionals on real-world client advisory engagements.

  • Build experience beyond traditional accounting or financial reporting into research and strategic advisory.

  • Take meaningful ownership of client work rather than being limited to one narrow finance function.

  • Develop a broader understanding of how financial information supports business strategy and decision-making.

  • Opportunity to grow into greater advisory and project responsibilities over time.

  • Join a fully remote team with a long-term opportunity for professional development.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Practical Financial Assessment for Finalists

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The practical assessment will take place after the client interview stage and will only be completed by final shortlisted candidates.

The Director, HEDIS Performance & Strategy leads the execution of enterprise initiatives to improve HEDIS measures aligned with Medicare Star Ratings. As a strategic partner to senior quality leadership, this role translates priorities into coordinated workstreams across markets and shared services, aligning operations, supplemental data, reporting, provider engagement, and quality improvement.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in HEDIS operations, Medicare Stars, supplemental data, and measure implementation, with the ability to analyze performance, influence matrixed stakeholders, and drive accountability.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Deployment & Operational Execution

  • Lead enterprise execution of Medicare HEDIS and Stars strategies by translating quality priorities into actionable measure-level workstreams.
  • Coordinate enterprise readiness planning for upcoming NCQA, CMS, HEDIS, and Stars measure changes.
  • Drive implementation of operational, documentation, coding, workflow, and supplemental data enhancements aligned to measure requirements.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment

  • Align Quality, Care Management, Pharmacy, Network, Provider Engagement, Analytics, IT, Supplemental Data, and market stakeholders around enterprise priorities, execution, and accountability.

Measure Performance Optimization

  • Analyze measure gaps, performance trends, supplemental data impact, chase outcomes, and intervention effectiveness to prioritize improvement opportunities.

Supplemental Data & HEDIS Operations

  • Assess opportunities for evaluation, integration, mapping, validation, and optimization of supplemental data sources in partnership with Systems and technical teams.
  • Ensure documentation workflows and source systems support data integrity, audit readiness, measure capture, and HEDIS reporting accuracy.

Program & Project Management

  • Maintain enterprise workplans, timelines, risks, dependencies, decisions, and progress reporting while driving stakeholder accountability and continuous improvement.

Executive Support & Communication

  • Develop executive materials, performance analyses, prioritization recommendations, and implementation updates for leadership and governance forums.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in HEDIS specifications, Medicare Star Ratings, supplemental data, and enterprise quality operations.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional Medicare quality initiatives and operational workstreams in matrixed organizations.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting performance data and operational impacts.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills.
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt preferred certification.

About OLX

OLX is a global leader in facilitating trade. It builds leading marketplace ecosystems enabled by tech, powered by trust, and loved by customers.

Serving tens of millions of people every month around the world, OLX helps people buy and sell cars, find housing, get jobs, buy and sell household goods, and much more. OLX is powered by global teams, united in a common purpose to build a more sustainable world through trade. For more information, visit .

OLX is backed by Prosus, a global consumer internet group and one of the largest technology investors in the world. Prosus has a primary listing on Euronext Amsterdam (AEX:PRX) and a secondary listing on the JSE Limited (XJSE:PRX), and is majority-owned by Naspers. For more information on Prosus and its companies and investments, please visit .

The Opportunity

OLX is looking for an experienced and hands-on Product Director to lead product function for our core horizontal marketplace, spanning household goods, electronics, and other general merchandise categories. This is a global role with responsibility for the strategy and execution of Horizontal across a focused set of European markets. You'll be a key voice shaping how this business grows within the broader OLX portfolio.

You'll lead a product organization of around 15 people, working closely with engineering, design, and commercial leadership to define and deliver a product roadmap that drives growth, engagement, and monetization for both consumers and sellers on the platform.

This role reports to Michael Bullion, Chief Product Officer.

What You'll Do

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Horizontal, in partnership with the CPO and broader leadership team.

  • Drive customer-centric product innovation with a focus on growth, retention, and monetization across the buyer and seller journeys.

  • Lead AI transformation for the horizontal domain

  • Lead the incubation, development & transition to a fully agentic horizontal marketplace.

  • Lead a product organization of around 15 people, with an emphasis on strong product management fundamentals — experimentation, documentation, and upstream opportunity discovery.

  • Work closely with engineering and commercial teams across markets to align product development with business priorities.

  • Identify and execute strategic opportunities, including creative monetization levers, cross-market improvements, and long-term category positioning.

  • Establish and scale best practices in product thinking and execution across your teams.

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product leaders.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across finance, commercial, and other functions to build consensus around strategy and priorities.

  • Act as a thought partner and sparring peer to other product and business leaders in shaping the future of OLX.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading product teams in online B2C/B2B2C environments, ideally in marketplaces, e-commerce, or classifieds. Experience navigating the dynamics of two-sided marketplaces (consumer buyers and sellers).

  • Strong hands-on product management background—not just a strategic leader, but someone who has built products and worked closely with engineers and commercial stakeholders.

  • Strategic thinker, able to balance long-term vision with short- and medium-term goals.

  • Experience in both 0->1 and scaling phases of product development.

  • Proven track record of jumping between domains and sectors. Ability to learn fast.

At OLX, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.
